mapper.select: select f.follow_up_id, f.resident_id, r.real_name as resident_name, r.id_card_no, r.gender, r.age, r.phone_number, CONCAT( IFNULL(p.region_name, ''), IFNULL(c.region_name, ''), IFNULL(d.region_name, ''), IFNULL(s.region_name, ''), IFNULL(cm.region_name, '') ) as full_region_name, f.result_id, sr.screening_type, sr.blood_result, sr.risk_level, sr.doctor_advice, f.follow_up_reason, f.follow_up_status, f.tracker_user_id, f.tracker_user_name, f.planned_visit_count, f.actual_visit_count, f.start_date, f.end_date, f.last_visit_time, f.follow_up_conclusion, f.create_time, f.remark from gc_follow_up f left join gc_resident r on f.resident_id = r.resident_id left join gc_region p on r.province_id = p.region_id left join gc_region c on r.city_id = c.region_id left join gc_region d on r.district_id = d.region_id left join gc_region s on r.street_id = s.region_id left join gc_region cm on r.community_id = cm.region_id left join gc_screening_result sr on f.result_id = sr.result_id where f.follow_up_id = #{followUpId}

mapper.select: select f.follow_up_id, f.result_id, sr.risk_level, f.follow_up_reason, f.follow_up_status, f.tracker_user_name, f.planned_visit_count, f.actual_visit_count, f.start_date, f.end_date, f.last_visit_time, f.create_time from gc_follow_up f left join gc_screening_result sr on f.result_id = sr.result_id where f.resident_id = #{residentId} order by f.create_time desc

select f.follow_up_id, f.resident_id, r.real_name as resident_name, r.phone_number, f.follow_up_reason, f.tracker_user_name, f.planned_visit_count, f.actual_visit_count, f.start_date, DATEDIFF(now(), f.start_date) as days_since_start from gc_follow_up f left join gc_resident r on f.resident_id = r.resident_id where f.follow_up_status = '0' order by f.start_date asc

select f.follow_up_id, f.resident_id, r.real_name as resident_name, r.phone_number, f.follow_up_reason, f.tracker_user_name, f.planned_visit_count, f.actual_visit_count, f.last_visit_time, DATEDIFF(now(), f.last_visit_time) as days_since_last_visit from gc_follow_up f left join gc_resident r on f.resident_id = r.resident_id where f.follow_up_status = '1' and f.last_visit_time < #{overdueDate} order by f.last_visit_time asc
